claim_scores.rationale: Uses the normal synchronous `Evaluate(...)(program)` call path exactly, with no async evaluation entrypoint.
Defines `async def async_metric(...)` and passes it directly to sync `Evaluate`, demonstrating the metric is invoked synchronously and returns a coroutine object.
Catches `TypeError` and asserts the message includes both `unsupported operand type(s)` and `coroutine`, matching failure during score aggregation with `sum(...)`.
Treats the sync evaluation as expected to fail before any normal `EvaluationResult` is returned, using `try/except` plus an `else` assertion.
